promptUnderstanding.reply: I need the intended percentage behavior and the verifier failure before a bounded fix can be scoped safely.
promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The user requests a narrowly scoped implementation for percentage behavior. Only src/calculator.ts and test/calculator.test.ts may be modified; .env, .git/**, bun.lock, and all other paths are protected. The user permits bun test when appropriate. The failing verifier evidence and expected percentage semantics have not been provided.

refinedBrief.goal: Implement the requested percentage behavior using the reported verifier failure as the basis for a bounded fix.
deliverables: A focused implementation change limited to src/calculator.ts.
Run bun test when execution is appropriate.
constraints: Do not modify .env, .git/**, bun.lock, or any other path.
Use the failing verifier evidence to bound the fix.
acceptanceCriteria: The agreed percentage behavior is implemented.
The supplied verifier failure is addressed without expanding the allowed file scope.
bun test passes when it can be run.
nonGoals: Changing files outside the two allowed writer paths.

questions.prompt: What exact percentage behavior should be implemented?
questions.rationale: Percentage handling can mean different operations and the correct behavior cannot be inferred safely.

options.label: Percent of value (Recommended)
